title: Feature Flags
subtitle: Control which optional features are visible and executable in the application
saveFailed: Feature flags could not be saved

contractsOpeningBalance.title: Contract opening balance
contractsOpeningBalance.description: Allow paid-through date and opening paid amount when creating or importing contracts.

contractsMultiLine.title: Multi-line contracts
contractsMultiLine.description: Allow contracts with multiple rental units and service lines.

odooImportCenter.title: Odoo invoice reconciliation
odooImportCenter.description: Compare local invoices with Odoo and approve exact links after review.

unitsCreateOdooProduct.title: Create Odoo product from unit
unitsCreateOdooProduct.description: Allow creating a new Odoo product from a local unit.

unitsLinkOdooProduct.title: Link unit to Odoo product
unitsLinkOdooProduct.description: Allow linking a local unit to an existing Odoo product.

unitsOdooCatalogButton.title: Load Odoo Products button
unitsOdooCatalogButton.description: Show the Odoo product catalog button on the Units page.

odooServiceCatalogButton.title: Service products button
odooServiceCatalogButton.description: Show the local Odoo service-product catalog and synchronization button on the Units page.

odooInvoicesDocuments.title: Odoo invoices and documents
odooInvoicesDocuments.description: Show Odoo invoice documents and allow Odoo invoice sync retries. Local invoice issue and payments stay available.

odooInvoiceManualSend.title: Manual send invoice to Odoo
odooInvoiceManualSend.description: Show the Send to Odoo button on invoices. Local invoice issuing stays available when this is off. Checking Odoo status for already linked invoices stays available.

importExcelContracts.title: Excel contract import
importExcelContracts.description: Allow importing contracts from Excel or CSV on the Import page.

reportsOperational.title: Operational reports
reportsOperational.description: Show Debt Aging and Location Statement report pages.

invoicesPaymentStatusPages.title: Partial and fully paid pages
invoicesPaymentStatusPages.description: Show the Partial Payments and Fully Paid invoice pages.

masterDataMutations.title: Unit and location editing
masterDataMutations.description: Allow creating, editing, deleting, and Excel-importing units and locations. Viewing remains available when disabled.

adminExperimental.title: Experimental Odoo admin tools
adminExperimental.description: Show advanced Odoo setup actions in Settings such as loading choices and creating a test draft invoice. Feature Flags stays available.
